name: Proton Calendar
description: Proton Calendar built into Spotty: sign in natively, see what is coming up, jump to any day
author: spotty
help:
Proton Calendar, built into Spotty

Installing adds the `cal` trigger and a Proton Calendar row under Settings → Search → Services and integrations. `cal` lists your next events; say when you mean to look: `cal tomorrow`, `cal friday`, `cal next week`, `cal +3d`, `cal in 2 weeks`, `cal 24 oct` or `cal 2026-10-24`; other words search the next two months (`cal dentist`). Enter opens Spotty's agenda window with day, week and month views and event details.

Sign in to Proton Calendar with your Proton account in its own sign-in window: your email, password and authenticator code if you use one. Calendar has its own sign-in and session; no other Proton app uses it. Spotty talks to Proton itself — no web page and no helper program. Your password becomes a one-time proof and is never stored; Spotty saves this app's session and a key password in an owner-only file and decrypts events on this computer, in memory only. Accounts protected only by a hardware security key can't sign in yet. Uninstalling removes the trigger only; Sign out in the settings ends this app's session and deletes its saved sign-in.
